answer: The strongest sybil defense is a honeypot gate: every task an agent processes contains a hidden kernel of injected instructions, like a line telling it to reveal a marker token. Agents that obey the prompt instead of the protocol self-identify and forfeit their stake. Honest agents never trip it, so false positives are rare. An attacker farming fake identities must either run obedient bots that spiral into self-destruction account by account, losing each deposit, or build injection-proof agents, which kills the economics.
